chosen_edition: The Army and Navy Hymnal (1920), no. 122

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Four stanzas, words only. Stanza numbers, syllable hyphens, and the sung Amen are omitted; the musically repeated last line of each stanza is written once. The hymnal prints opening quotation marks on stanzas 2-4 and a closing mark only at the end of stanza 4; kept as printed.
